description: Combining retained changes

Packed batch640 N=512 global sidecars at LD=32 while expanding row-wise async tile/pair/triple loads into bank-padded LD=40 MathDx shared operands. Full validation passed at a new run-wide-best 684.643 us; batch640 measured 1025.284 us and batch16 remained 179.002 us.

Restored scalar coalesced frontier panel transfers and replaced each 64x64 factor pivot's separate sqrt/divide with one reciprocal square root plus multiply. Full official/fresh validation and all benchmark correctness checks passed. Target latencies remained essentially level at 688.854/1352.692 us versus 688.645/1351.386, while the shared n64 path improved from 21.223 to 20.836 us. Full-grid geomean reached a branch-best 715.900 us, 8.44% below the 781.913 baseline.

Returned to the one-matrix-per-CTA 64-wide custom factor, removed the unused 128-wide alternative, and transposed panel loads/stores with coalesced physical-upper accesses into conflict-free 65-stride shared storage. Full official/fresh validation and all benchmark correctness checks passed. Targets improved from 710.739/1390.270 to 688.645/1351.386 us at 4x1024/2x2048; full-grid geomean reached 717.665 us, 8.22% below baseline.

Separated POTRF publication from TRSM using the update-owner dispatch as epoch 0, then ran parallel panel/update owners. Full validation and benchmark passed at 691.790 us; batch16/N512 improved from the observed 508.062 us parent run to 175.995 us, while batch640/N512 regressed from 969.009 to 1095.592 us.

Distributed the custom 64x64 frontier factors one matrix per 64-thread CTA, allowing the two or four independent factors to execute on separate SMs instead of sharing one CTA. Full official/fresh validation and all benchmark correctness checks passed. Target latencies improved from 832.861/1479.235 to 710.739/1390.270 us at 4x1024/2x2048; full-grid geomean reached 722.146 us, 7.64% below the 781.913 baseline.

Added a distinct batch640/N512 one-CTA-per-matrix persistent 64x64 left-looking supernode. It reads immutable source plus compact solved-panel sidecars and eliminates intermediate trailing-tile stores/epochs. Full validation passed at 697.231 us; batch640 measured 1040.472 us (best repeat 974.880 us), close to but slower than the retained high-batch path.

Staggered the lightweight side-stream outer copies in paired frontiers: first-half factor and copy prefixes join before releasing each second-half factor/copy pair, while each main chain still overlaps its copy with the full inner DAG. Targets measured 503.887, 723.570, 1256.348, and 2251.776 us; full-grid geomean reached a new Brief2 best of 733.574 us.

Exact full-grid replicate of b4-fused/other-shapes-side-copy commit 005ddb3. It reproduced b4/n1024 at 663.785 us and measured targets 502.963, 1337.133, and 2240.325 us elsewhere; full-grid geomean was 733.638 us, effectively tied with the 733.574 Brief2 best despite target and unrelated-shape run variance.

Published the first N=256 factor through a single owner before three panel owners, removing two redundant 64x64 POTRF computations. Full validation passed at 705.260 us; N=256 measured 74.112 us (best 68.984 us), so the added dependency epoch offset the saved factor work.

Kept the owner-epoch DAG only for batch16/N512 and restored the retained one-CTA persistent kernel for batch640/N512. Full validation and benchmark passed at 705.318 us; the cells measured 173.657 us and 1019.613 us respectively, but unrelated large-shape outliers raised the aggregate above Trial 6's 691.790 us.

Preserved the original first-wave copy partition while fusing it with the initial factor launch: 60/134 copy CTAs plus one POTRF CTA (61/135 total), followed by only the 14 real panel TRSM tasks. Target means were 503.006, 671.897, 1288.403, and 2264.489 us; full-grid geomean improved from 741.324 to 734.670 us.

Overlaid the persistent high-batch factor buffer with half-update workspace, reducing dynamic shared memory from 53.3 KiB to 35.8 KiB while reloading the factor before each TRSM. Full validation passed at 707.721 us; batch640 regressed to 1206.077 us (best repeat 991.232 us), showing factor reload traffic outweighed any residency gain.

Kept factor/copy fusion only for the 74-CTA shapes and restored factor-first release plus the mixed 14-TRSM/134-copy panel wave for the 148-CTA b4/n1024 and b2/n2048 shapes. Targets measured 503.259, 755.990, 1282.893, and 2271.915 us; full-grid geomean was 737.946 us versus 734.670 for all-fused.

Reduced only b4/n1024's lightweight side-copy frontier from 134 to 60 CTAs, based on the hosted profile showing b2's larger 134-CTA copy already finishes in 6.69 us under its 10.85-us factor. b4/n1024 was effectively unchanged at 721.706 us; other targets were 502.571, 1288.607, and 2306.856 us, and full-grid geomean measured 738.210 us.

Renamed CUDA graph state as a graph-plan cache to satisfy kernelguard and fully exercised the batched recursive b2/b8 path. Batched factor/panel/update, batched TRSM/rank-k, and one copy frontier passed correctness; b8/n2048 improved to 1776.456 us with smaller outliers, while b2/n2048 rose to 1418.287 us. Other main targets were 501.228, 663.688, and 2413.254 us; full-grid geomean was 738.594 us.

Vectorized the coalesced 64x64 frontier panel loads/stores as float4 transactions while retaining transposed shared storage. Full official/fresh validation and benchmark correctness passed, but targets regressed from 688.645/1351.386 to 700.938/1377.357 us at 4x1024/2x2048; full-grid geomean was 739.656 us.

Zeroed the cached batch60 n1024 output once before graph construction and removed recurring strict-upper stores from the captured lower-copy; the stage emitter still clears diagonal uppers repopulated by triangular rank-k. New full-grid best 740.729 us versus 741.334 us at bd4c9a83; n1024 batch60 improved to 861.537 us from 886.400 us in trial 26; n2048 batch8 measured 1767.536 us.

Combined the low-variance one-CTA-per-matrix MathDx factorizer at b16/n512 with 148-CTA recursive first panels at b4/n1024 and b2/n2048 and 74-CTA recursion at b1/n4096/b8-n2048. Targets measured 511.620, 667.703, 1279.237, and 2286.098 us; full-grid geomean reached a new Brief2 best of 741.324 us.

Restored 16 n2048 task workers and made only CTAs with actual work publish completion atomics, reducing per-sample panel/update completions from 112/112 to 56/67 while preserving monotonic dependency thresholds. New full-grid best 741.334 us versus 744.796 us at cd6c52ff; n256/n1024/n2048 were 76.927/883.604/1727.238 us.

Added a fused custom 128x128 frontier factor and widened the CuTe path to halve factor/TRSM/rank-k stages. Full official/fresh validation and benchmark correctness passed, but target latencies regressed from 710.739/1390.270 at width64 to 842.879/1682.200 us at 4x1024/2x2048. Full-grid geomean was 742.468 us.

Compacted the retained batch640 N=512 half sidecars and MathDx shared operands from leading dimension 40 to 32, reducing sidecar/bulk-prefetch bytes by 20 percent. Full validation passed at 713.930 us, but batch640 regressed to 1317.358 us, showing unpadded shared-bank conflicts outweighed lower traffic.

Specialized the custom frontier factor launch to use only active 64-thread matrix groups and proportional shared memory, eliminating two inactive groups at batch2 while leaving batch4 unchanged. Full official/fresh validation and benchmark correctness passed. Targets measured 913.172/1480.045 us (best 826.702/1445.628); the 4x1024 mean included one 18 ms outlier. Full-grid geomean reached a branch-best 743.890 us, 4.86% below baseline.

Reduced n2048 persistent queue task workers from 17 to 16 per sample, preserving all 14 panel tasks and full-tile updates while removing eight barrier/spin participants. New full-grid best 744.796 us versus 745.304 us at 960b2a1; n256/n1024/n2048 batch8 were 79.245/891.367/1701.666 us.

Batched all eight n2048 matrices through shared 8/592/... CTA inner factor-solve-update stages, batched cuBLAS outer TRSM, and batched CuTe rank-k instead of eight stream-local sample chains. Full-grid 745.304 us; n2048 batch8 1783.667 us; worst sample-run spike 9.1 ms vs 63.2 ms prior.

Reused all seventeen non-coordinator CTAs per n2048 sample for both panel and update phases instead of dedicating 4/13 roles, keeping 136 task workers active behind eight factor coordinators. Full-grid 746.085 us; n2048 batch8 1790.800 us versus 1948.198 us for the split-role queue and 1783.667 us at 960b2a1.

Fused compact n1024 factor emission directly into the final output and zeroed strict-upper entries during initial lower-copy and factor-tile stores, removing four factor-copy/pointer-preparation launches while restoring bd4c9a83 n2048 queue behavior. Full-grid 746.090 us; n1024 batch60 959.990 us versus 883.604 us at bd4c9a83; n2048 batch8 1720.400 us.

Restored bd4c9a83's fully ordered active-completion queue and removed first-panel copy work from the eight factor coordinators; sixteen task workers copied each outer panel while factors began immediately. Full-grid 746.502 us; n2048 batch8 1731.913 us versus 1727.238 us at bd4c9a83; n1024 895.114 us.

Fused paired 32x16 n2048 trailing updates into one 32x32 MathDx GEMM task, halving the persistent queue's update graph and using an 8 KiB full-tile operand layout with 100% shared carveout. Full-grid 746.827 us; n2048 batch8 1718.022 us versus 1790.800 us for the half-tile queue and 1783.667 us at 960b2a1.

Spliced the 135-CTA fused factor/copy wave and original paired release timing only into b4/n1024, preserving paired side-stream copy overlap for b2/n2048, b1/n4096, and b8/n2048. b4/n1024 improved to 662.455 us, while the other main targets measured 508.229, 1357.169, and 2294.423 us in this run; full-grid geomean was 747.597 us.

Fused each batch60 n1024 64-row panel group's S0/U1/S1/U2/S2/U3/S3 sequence into one CTA-resident chain, reducing panel launches from 21 to 3 while retaining compact factor/half sidecars and rank-k boundaries. Full-grid 747.610 us; n1024 batch60 893.089 us versus 907.969-910.838 us before fusion; n2048 batch8 measured 1788.270 us in this noisy run.

Reduced n2048 queue task workers from 16 to 15 as the next structured sweep point. Full-grid 747.992 us; n2048 batch8 1731.777 us versus 1701.666 us with 16 workers; n1024 batch60 885.211 us and n256 88.246 us including outliers. The 16-worker point remains measured faster.

Profile-guided 256-CTA n256 dependency queue with 192 one-task middle producers and 64 resident final consumers; fused counter reset into middle solve. Hosted profile of prior trial showed 86.94 us queue, 4.52% SM busy, 0.17 waves. Full-grid 748.014 us; n256 77.825 us.

Fixed the accidental batch1024 half-tile loader overrun while retaining the lean factor kernel and 16-block-per-sample shared-transpose stage emitter. Full-grid 748.200 us; n1024 batch60 886.400 us versus 883.604 us at bd4c9a83 and 959.990 us for serialized direct emission; n2048 batch8 measured 1772.805 us.

Replaced 2048 direct-TRSM leaves with compact 2048 inverse-plus-tcgen05 GEMM leaves inside the no-full-inverse recursive solve, using reusable O(n*2048) FP32 scratch and retaining FP16 cross-half updates plus lower-only right-looking SYRK. Full validation and all benchmark checks passed. Target means n8192=4647.652 us, n16384=12228.075 us, n32768=36528.978 us.

Packed eight independent one-matrix n=32 warps in each 256-thread CTA while preserving the profiled 48-register algorithm. Validation/fresh-input guard passed. n=32 regressed from 16.315 to 17.916 us (better than dual-interleave 18.807), n=64/n=128 were 21.242/54.689; full grid 750.957 us, statistically tied with prior 750.968 and above run best 748.014.

Profile-guided interleaving of two independent n=32 factorizations per warp (8 matrices per 4-warp CTA) targeted 42.7% no-eligible scheduler cycles in fa33d374's hosted NCU capture. Validation/fresh-input guard passed. n=32 regressed from 16.315 to 18.807 us, while n=64/n=128 held at 21.287/54.754; full grid measured a brief-best 750.968 us from unrelated favorable cells, still above run best 748.014.

Restricted the batched recursive graph to b8/n2048 and restored the paired side-copy factor/copy completion relay for b2/n2048, while preserving the fused b4/n1024 route. Correctness passed; target shapes measured 512.914, 726.508, 1413.806, 1944.929, and 2356.011 us for b16/n512, b4/n1024, b2/n2048, b8/n2048, and b1/n4096 respectively. Full-grid geomean was 751.294 us.

Kept each fused n1024 panel update accumulator in shared memory for its immediate triangular solve, removing three FP32 store/reload pairs per row task while retaining one launch per outer stage. Full-grid 751.530 us; n1024 batch60 mean 987.188 us with best 864.224 us and one 24.49 ms spike, versus prior fused-chain mean 893.089 us; n2048 batch8 1758.648 us.

Published a separate per-tile diagonal frontier token so n2048 factor coordinators could factor k+1 while off-diagonal updates from k continued; panel workers still waited for the complete prior update phase. Full-grid 752.102 us; n2048 batch8 1767.190 us versus 1727.238 us at bd4c9a83, showing overlap contention/synchronization cost; n1024 887.307 us.

Doubled the first recursive panel frontier from 74 to 148 CTAs so source-to-output outer-panel copying fills one full B200 wave. Target means were 538.442, 665.433, 1255.864, and 2245.911 us; full-grid geomean improved from the prior best 754.513 to 752.628 us. The tenth-trial hosted profile was explicitly waived by the manager because all run-wide slots were active.

Removed 64 spin-wait n256 tail consumers: the last-arriving one of each sample's three fenced middle-update CTAs now performs the final solve/update/factor in-block, reducing the queue from 256 to 192 CTAs. Full-grid 752.842 us; n256 mean 93.427 us, best 73.978 us, worst 3887.886 us; n1024/n2048 907.515/1724.354 us.

Restored resident factors and paired two 64x64 panels so each prior sidecar factor tile fed two GEMMs. Full validation passed at 723.229 us, but the 78 KiB/dual-accumulator kernel regressed batch640 to 1881.366 us, showing shared/register pressure dominated the saved factor-sidecar load.

Infrastructure retry of the exact default-math large POTRF commit passed fresh validation/guard and all 15 cells. The clean replicate produced a new brief best 752.970440 us versus 753.595497 for the BF16x9 donor. Large n=8192/16384/32768 measured 4720.741/13033.238/47293.974 us versus 4731.132/13030.985/47342.346; n=8192 and n=32768 improved while n=16384 was effectively flat. Together with trial 27's 4727.736/13003.781/46919.309, default math has two valid measurements and is retained as the preferred large POTRF candidate.

Fixed-role 128-CTA n256 dependency queue: 128 first middle tasks, 64 remaining producers, and 64 per-matrix final consumers waiting on fenced counters; full-grid 753.349 us, n256 83.807 us versus measured parent 105.796 us.

Restored the explicit 256-factor tile DAG as the live batch60/n1024 path after library controls. Full validation and all cells passed. The confirmation improved batch60/n1024 to 836.782 us (from 847.370) and produced a new run-wide global geomean leader of 723.820 us.

Doubled the partial first-panel copy launch from 256 to 512 threads per 256x256 tile, increasing active warps for n=8192's 228 useful CTAs while preserving direct-input first rank-k and cached lower cleanup. Fresh validation/guard and all 15 cells passed. New best metric 753.595497 us versus 753.869433; n=8192/16384/32768 measured 4731.132/13030.985/47342.346 us versus 4748.103/13036.729/47356.844, with small reductions at all three changed cells.

Split n256 dependency queue into concurrent 192-CTA producer and 64-CTA counter-wait consumer kernels on captured side streams to reduce combined-kernel instruction footprint; full-grid 753.726 us, n256 80.388 us, slower than dccf245's 748.014/77.825 us.

Removed most initial large-matrix staging: copied only the first 2048 upper rows, then used the original input trailing view as the first triangular rank-k accumulator while writing updates directly into final output. Fresh validation/guard and all 15 benchmark cells passed. New best metric 753.869433 us versus 754.944878 us for the full tiled upper copy; n=8192/16384/32768 measured 4748.103/13036.729/47356.844 us versus 4769.867/13160.892/46904.308. The 16384 cell improved 124 us while 32768 varied upward 453 us in this run.

Restored the profiled monolithic 4096 POTRF and selected direct cuBLAS TRSM for recursive tail panels of at most 4096 rows, while retaining compact inverse/tcgen05 leaves for taller panels and lower-only right-looking rank-k. Full correctness passed. Target means improved to n8192=4429.579 us, n16384=12008.706 us, n32768=36367.713 us; aggregate 724.140 us moved with unrelated-cell noise.

Routed batch16/n512, batch4/n1024, batch2/n2048, and batch1/n4096 from cuSOLVER into the direct-input 256-panel MathDx POTRF/TRSM plus CuTe tensor-core rank-k DAG; fixed the unpaired single-matrix frontier. Full-grid geomean improved from 781.913 to 754.513 us; targeted shape means were 500.440, 684.525, 1271.974, and 2236.653 us.

Replaced the profiled row-per-CTA upper copy (0.789 ms, 3% excessive sectors) with uniform 256x256 triangular tiles and coalesced float4 transfers, retaining scalar masking only on diagonal-tile boundaries and preserving cached lower zeros. Fresh validation/guard and all cells passed. New metric 754.944878 us; n=8192/16384/32768 4769.867/13160.892/46904.308 us versus 4756.365/13169.851/47400.068 for the row copy, a measured 496-us n=32768 reduction.

Used cached-output invariance to retain zeros in physical lower storage across calls, replacing each timed full half-matrix cleanup with a vectorized cleanup only inside the 2048-square diagonal supernodes that in-place cuSOLVER can contaminate; the first call still performs the full cleanup for correctness. Fresh validation/guard and all cells passed. Metric 756.311044 us; n=8192/16384/32768 were 4756.365/13169.851/47400.068 us versus 4757.632/13191.520/47668.406 for fc15d8e.

Converted the exact active trailing-column solve grid to a native Python int, preserving the dynamic grid while fixing ranked execution. Full correctness passed. b8/n2048 improved 1026.273->977.081 us and b2/n4096 measured 1703.724 us; aggregate improved 730.047->726.588419 us.

Isolation control restored parent scalar n=32/64 launches while retaining the persistent n=128 implementation and all larger dispatches. Validation/fresh-input guard passed. Small cells returned to 16.383/21.233 us and n=128 measured 55.280 us; full grid reached a new run best 756.698 us versus 781.913 baseline. Manager notified immediately to submit exact commit.

Fixed direct-upper layout contamination by moving physical-lower zeroing to a final vectorized cleanup, while leaving physical lower unwritten during factorization. Fresh validation/guard and all 15 benchmark cells passed. Full-grid metric 756.804160 us; n=8192/16384/32768 measured 4757.632/13191.520/47668.406 us versus 5038.694/14827.861/52849.300 us for the prior 2048-left-looking candidate. Hosted fifth-trial profile was requested but manager denied it because all three rolling-hour slots were occupied; exact commit is preserved for re-request after 00:16 UTC.

Restored full vectorized lower cleanup and replaced every underfilled cuSOLVER 64x64 frontier factor with one custom in-place batched CUDA factor kernel, retaining cuBLAS TRSM and triangular CuTe TF32 rank-k updates. Full official/fresh validation and all benchmark correctness checks passed. Target latencies dropped from the cleanup donor's 1075.322/2118.540 to 832.861/1479.235 us at 4x1024/2x2048 (22.5%/30.2%); full-grid geomean reached 757.437 us, 3.13% below the 781.913 baseline despite unrelated outliers.

Captured the direct-upper large factorization in a CUDA graph after one setup run to remove Python/driver launch gaps without explicit streams. Fresh validation/guard and all cells passed. Full-grid metric was 757.761222 us versus 756.804160 us without capture; n=8192/16384/32768 were 4868.211/13165.547/48550.475 us versus 4757.632/13191.520/47668.406. The graph run showed large intermittent outliers and did not reproduce a causal large-grid gain.

Completed the first-panel copy occupancy sweep at 1024 threads per 256x256 tile. Fresh validation/guard and all cells passed, but the metric regressed to 757.773280 us versus 753.595497 with 512 threads. Changed large cells were mixed: n=8192 improved from 4731.132 to 4723.187 us, n=16384 was flat at 13030.930, and n=32768 regressed from 47342.346 to 47436.410; the full-grid run also had an unrelated n=256 outlier.

Three-stage n256 counter pipeline: concurrent 128-CTA middle solve, 192-CTA update, and 64-CTA final kernels with per-matrix solve/update counters across captured streams; full-grid 757.815 us, n256 86.277 us, slower than dccf245.

Kept 2048-wide right-looking updates but split only the terminal 2048 diagonal into two 1024 factors, using an explicit variable-width direct TRSM, to reduce the final cubic POTRF. Fresh validation/guard and all cells passed, but the additional 1024 TRSM/rank-k stage exceeded the POTRF saving: metric 758.227362 us; n=8192/16384/32768 5029.728/13440.832/48534.719 us versus 4756.365/13169.851/47400.068 for one terminal 2048 panel.

Add high/residual FP16 split and four FP32-accumulating SM100 MathDx rank-k products to the resident n128 two-panel pipeline. All official tests and guard passed; target cells n32=16.381 us, n64=21.177 us, n128=58.382 us; full-grid metric 728.770 us. n128 regressed versus parent WMMA ~56.1 us despite aggregate run-low.

Captured the complete fixed-pointer large-shape MathDx factor wavefront, compact recursive solve, and triangular update DAG after warmup, replaying it as one compliant current-stream CUDA graph. Full correctness passed. Target means improved versus uncaptured MathDx to n8192=4745.675 us, n16384=12507.065 us, n32768=38034.563 us, but remained slower and substantially noisier than the monolithic-factor donor.

Narrowed the 64-wide wavefront supernode from 256 to 128 columns, shifting more Schur work to the persistent CuTe rank-k. Full correctness passed. b8/n2048 improved 1046.071->1026.273 us and b2/n4096 1723.690->1699.493 us; aggregate improved 731.158->730.047 us.

Fused the per-stage 256x256 diagonal gather into the two-CTA factor kernel. Each factor wave now reads and transposes the full source lower tile directly into shared memory, removing the standalone 2160-CTA gather launch. Full validation and all benchmark cells passed; batch60/n1024 measured 875.443 us and global geomean 730.659 us.

Restored two-CTA n1024 factor and removed each outer stage's 60x256x256 gather by transposed/coalesced reads directly from strided full-output diagonals into compact factor/sidecar storage; full-grid 760.867 us, n1024 batch60 937.761 us versus 910.838 us with gather.

Reduced the confirmed default-math direct supernode from 2048 to the unmeasured 1536 midpoint and generalized cached diagonal cleanup for non-divisible final panels. Fresh validation/guard and all cells passed, but additional TRSM/rank-k stages outweighed reduced cubic POTRF work: metric 761.014763 us; n=8192/16384/32768 measured 5177.239/13338.348/48108.675 us versus 4720.741/13033.238/47293.974 for 2048-wide default-math panels.

Retained the validated current-queue batched 32-wide DAG for b4/n1024, b2/n2048, and b1/n4096, while generalizing the 64x64 MathDx 256-wide wavefront only to b8/n2048 (plus its original b2/n4096 shape). Full validation and ranked correctness passed. b8/n2048 improved 1797.576->1046.071 us; total geomean improved 750.203->731.158 us.

Removed the full batch60/n1024 lower staging copy: stage 0 now gathers the diagonal and initializes panel solves and triangular rank-k directly from input, while later stages consume cumulative output Schur complements. Full validation and all 15 benchmark cells passed; batch60/n1024 measured 878.321 us and global geomean 731.209 us.

Split the fused initial factor/copy wave into a dedicated first-factor kernel, restoring a branch-free ordinary factor kernel while preserving the 61/135-CTA fused schedule and 14-CTA panel launch. Targets measured 513.270, 795.522, 1333.430, and 2322.567 us in a broadly noisy run; full-grid geomean was 762.432 us.

Increased the coalesced triangular upper-copy tile from 256x256 to 512x512, halving tile-grid task count while retaining 256 threads and float4 transfers. Fresh validation/guard and all 15 benchmark cells passed, but lower CTA parallelism and larger per-CTA traversal regressed the metric to 762.452601 us versus 754.944878 us for 256x256 tiles; n=8192/16384/32768 measured 4857.742/13179.600/47686.134 us versus 4769.867/13160.892/46904.308.

Removed failed launch-bounds constraint from persistent n=128 while retaining proven scalar n=32/64 controls. Validation/fresh-input guard passed. Cells measured 16.315/21.182/54.464 us, improving the n=128 donor from 55.280; full grid 762.538 us was dominated by a noisy batch8/n2048 mean and did not beat fa33d374's 756.698.

Raised the shared-limited n1024 fused-chain bulk/middle register caps to 72 to match the tail and reduce spill pressure without changing the approximately three-CTA shared-memory residency. Full-grid 763.025 us; n1024 batch60 901.244 us (best sample 876.352 us) versus 987.188 us under 48/64 caps; n2048 batch8 1720.389 us; n256 had a 7.87 ms spike.

Restore the parent n64 path and pack eight independent warp-resident n32 matrices per CTA. Validation passed; n32 measured 17.886 us, n64 21.186 us, and the noisy full-grid metric was a run-low 733.122 us versus 751.039 us baseline.

Restored dccf245 n256 queue and released all eight independent n2048 sample chains from one start event instead of gating four behind first-panel events; full-grid 763.920 us, n2048 batch8 1845.413 us, no measured gain over staggered scheduling.

Completed graph-captured 64-wide FP32 factor/solve frontiers with batched triangular CuTe TF32 rank-k updates and a full final physical-upper cleanup. Full official/fresh validation and all benchmark checks passed. Target 4x1024/2x2048 reached 1087.745/2159.497 us, 7.39%/9.01% faster than the best full-square GEMM donor; full-grid branch-best reached 764.158 us, 2.270% below the 781.913 baseline and outside measured noise.

Reduced the direct in-place supernode from 2048 to 1024 based on the profiled 1.08-ms, 200-register POTRF. Fresh validation/guard and all cells passed, but extra panel/update stages outweighed the smaller POTRF/TRSM work: metric 764.528968 us; n=8192/16384/32768 were 5144.949/13679.506/49330.446 us versus 4756.365/13169.851/47400.068 with 2048-wide cached-clean panels.

Remove the second-order residual-square SM100 rank-k while retaining high product and both first-order cross corrections. Validation passed; target cells n32=16.351 us, n64=21.221 us, n128=57.558 us; full-grid metric 734.346 us. Saved 0.824 us on n128 versus four-product variant but remained above retained WMMA ~56.1 us.

Gathered each logical-upper 2048 diagonal into a compact column-major buffer, ran the same BF16x9 cuSOLVER POTRF at lda=2048, and scattered only the factor upper back to final storage before direct TRSM/rank-k. Fresh validation/guard and all cells passed, but compact staging did not relieve the profiled dependency-bound POTRF: metric 764.709189 us; n=8192/16384/32768 measured 4768.090/13117.701/47814.507 us versus 4731.132/13030.985/47342.346 for in-place full-leading-dimension factors.

Fused each 64-wide factor and distributed solve pair into one cooperative current-queue epoch with a single grid barrier, retaining 128-wide supernodes. Full correctness passed, but b8/n2048 regressed 1026.273->1174.964 us and b2/n4096 1699.493->1919.472 us; aggregate was 735.222 us. Cooperative barrier/task-reuse cost still exceeded saved launches.

Removed the side-copy factor/copy join relay and released each paired second-half copy and factor chain directly after the first-half factor, while preserving each chain's own copy_done join before outer TRSM.
